summary: Fresh independent audit of the curated canonical extraction after 7ac07906b3. All 162 Chinese units, all six temporal or active-hint items, and all three people were rechecked. 至元曆經 in s0115 is a bibliographical calendar-classic title, not a regnal-date event: it cannot date Guo Shoujing, Qi Lüqian, or Li Qian to AD 1264–1294. The repair correctly retains each title-context attestation and explicit research-required hold, but the chapter contains no personal chronology that can resolve those holds.
